verdict.rationale: The Open Finance API lets an agent retrieve balances and transactions. Accounts are linked via Connect, and access tokens come from Partner ID, secret and appKey, so a programmatic agent can call the core data endpoints. However, the official MCP server is a developer-documentation and code-generation aid, not an operational surface for acting on customer data. Credentials are partner-wide secrets with no documented scoping. Missing for 10: an MCP surface that executes platform operations, documented scoped or least-privilege agent credentials, detailed link-session creation and connection-management endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
